indications_and_usage: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE Examplamide is a fictional compound used only in MedGuard unit tests.
contraindications:
4 CONTRAINDICATIONS
Examplamide is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to examplamide or to any excipient.
warnings_and_cautions:
5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS
5.1 Renal function: monitor serum creatinine in patients with heart failure — Nierenfunktion überwachen (µmol/L).

5.2 Hyperkalemia: concomitant use with potassium-sparing diuretics may increase serum potassium ≥ 5,5 mmol/L.
Français : hyperkaliémie possible.
drug_interactions:
7 DRUG INTERACTIONS
7.1 Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (NSAIDs): co-administration with examplamide may result in deterioration of renal function — „Triple Whammy“.
